cells.value: DBM Budget Preparation (BP) Forms - FY 2027 Budget
Source: DBM 'Compliance with Good Governance Conditions' page > II. Annual Financial Reports > D. BP Forms (the 21 forms listed there).

These PDFs are DBM-Office of the Secretary's own filled-in FY2027 submission, mostly scanned. Each tab rebuilds one form's layout (title block, header fields, every column header with its numbering, row structure, notes and sign-off) and adds a few sample rows from DBM's copy.

Legend: blue text = sample entries from DBM's submission (replace or delete them); yellow rows = blank rows to fill in; black = labels and formulas. Amounts are in thousand pesos unless the tab says otherwise.
Transcribed by eye from scanned pages, so check any figure you reuse against the original PDF. 'ASSUMED' in a tab's notes marks something the PDF does not show.

- Amounts are in pesos, not thousands. Sections: TIER 1 / TIER 2, each with A. Casual and B. Contractual, plus sub-totals.
- Formulas: (8) = Monthly Salary x (7); (22) = SUM of (9)-(21); (23) = (8) + (22). In DBM's figures RLIP = 12% of (8) and PHIC = 2.5% of (8), capped.
- Sample rows are the first contractual positions in DBM-OSEC's FY2027 staffing summary.

Terminal leave factor (daily rate / leave credit)
- Amounts are in pesos. DBM redacted the retirees' names in its published copy. The personal dates (birth, appointment, retirement) are also left out of these sample rows.
- Terminal leave Amount (9) = Highest Monthly Salary (6) x [VL (7) + SL (8)] x 0.0481927 (the daily-rate factor). This reproduces DBM's figures, e.g. 19,106 x 96.367 x 0.0481927 = 88,731.82.
- Sign-off: PREPARED BY (Chief Administrative Officer, AS-HRMD) / APPROVED BY (Assistant Director, AS) / DAY/MO/YR.
